newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian opposition create "Forum for Democracy".
newsitem.headline: Albanian opposition create "Forum for Democracy".

text.p: Seven Albanian opposition parties, including the large Socialist Party, said on Thursday they had formed a joint alliance to press for the resignation of the government in the wake of a huge investment scandal.

The alliance, dubbed the Forum for Democracy, which also includes an association of ex-prisoners from the communist era, promised to investigate the collapse of high-yielding pyramid savings schemes which has sparked nationwide rioting.
"The association and the parties want the resignation of the government and the creation of a technocrat government," the Forum said in a joint statement.
The ruling right-wing Democrat government launched a wave of arrests around the poor Balkan state on Wednesday following a weekend of violence.

The Socialist Party, the largest opposition group in Albania and the reformed heirs of the old communist elite, denounced the arrests. They have joined forces with both centre-left and rightist parties in the Forum.
